body.x: Jungan Healthcare will introduce its healing mood light Color Therating Happy Light for comfortable sleep at CES 2020, which will be held in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10.
This line was invented by CEO Jeon Seung-won, who studied oriental medicine, by adding therating feature that can help improve health to the mood light that improves mood.

In addition, there are inherent health functions such as Color Therating, Music Therating and Aroma Therating, which stabilize the mind and body through color, music, and scent. In addition, it is equipped with a wireless charging function for mobile phones to enhance convenience, and also includes a Bluetooth speaker function and a backup battery function to further enhance usability.

The company official from the company said,“We have attracted investment of $1.12 for export to the US and establishedoverseas corporate to contribute to the health of the world. We want to makeTherating as a brand and our mission and philosophy known to the world byforming a global marketing team and entering the US, Europe, and SoutheastAsia."
